action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Moment.js did not properly validate locale names. If
an application passed an untrusted locale name to Moment.js, an attacker
could possibly use this issue to load arbitrary files from the file system.
isummary:
Moment.js could be made to load arbitrary files if it received specially
crafted input.
title: Moment.js vulnerability
